steps.note: A clean page exits 0 so the job stays green.
A changed source exits 1 with an ::error annotation titled with the rule id.
A moved source is a ::warning and exits 0.
A moved claim is a ::notice and exits 0.
An operational error (no inputs, no config) exits 2.

scaffolding: Repo fixtures under test/fixtures/ (the page's examples map onto them); cwd = manni repo root with the built CLI linked as `manni` / `npx @hawkeyexl/manni`.
